title: Sibte Payambar Alweda
body:
Sibte Payamber Alvida, Jaan E Payamber Alvida
Jaan E Payamber Alvida, Sibte Payamber Alvida
1. Aati Hai Har Ghar Se Saada, Kar Na Sake Maatam Tera
Haq Na Aada Hum Se Huwa, Aye Shah E Besar Alvida
<<MINI>>
Sibte Payamber....
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Aaoun O Mohammed Alvida, Abbas O Akber Alvida
Aye Ibne Shabbar Alvida, Aye Payse Asgher Alvida
<<MINI>>
Sibte Payamber....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ibne Ali Zainab Ke Chaain, Aye Fatima Ke Noor E Aain Abbas Ke Bhai Hussain, Aye Jaan E Khwaher Alvida
<<MINI>>
Sibte Payamber....
